subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Vertebrae are bone structures that form the backbone of vertebrate animals.
• Vertebrae provide support and protect the spinal cord, which controls movement.
• Members of the same species typically have the same number of vertebrae.
• The python (Python regius) and the cobra (Naja naja) are species of snakes.
• The python has approximately 400 vertebrae.
• The cobra has approximately 200 vertebrae.
prompt: The student wants to specify how many vertebrae the python has. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The python's vertebrae provide support and protect the spinal cord, which controls the snake's movement.
choices.B: The python (Python regius) and the cobra (Naja naja) both have vertebrae, but the python has more than the cobra does.
choices.C: The cobra, a species of snake, has approximately 200 bone structures called vertebrae.
choices.D: The python (Python regius) has approximately 400 vertebrae.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence directly specifies how many vertebrae the python has, as indicated in the notes: approximately 400.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence specifies how many vertebrae the cobra has, not how many the python has.
